crossRefs.note: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know…
But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
crossRefs.keyword: vanished out of their sight. or, ceased to be seen of them

translations.web: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, then he vanished out of their sight.
